purpose: Read-only proof that quality cleanup did not alter the six protected financial and authorization implementations.
baseline_snapshot: Frozen 2026-10-15 baseline; raw snapshot path and source hashes retained in ignored local verification evidence
algorithm: SHA-256 of JSON-encoded PHP token sequence [token_id,text] or [literal,text], discarding only T_COMMENT, T_DOC_COMMENT and T_WHITESPACE. Both inputs are parsed by the same PHP tokenizer. No source content is copied into this report.
unchanged_semantics_verified: Payment_Attempts: unique per-order INSERT IGNORE, BINARY compare-and-swap, durable states and flags, no automatic expiry/retry, GET_LOCK/RELEASE_LOCK reconciliation serialization, approved-before-WooCommerce-completion ordering and capability checks.
Attempt_Command: explicit core WP-CLI user identity, order capabilities, exact attempt and merchant evidence inputs, worker-stopped confirmation, no provider request or automatic retry.
Payment_Input: card type/length/Luhn/expiry/CVV/name validation, trusted positive KYD order amount checks, integer minor-unit arithmetic and bounded transaction reference validation.
Provider_Request: component-wise rawurlencode of existing scalar provider values; no field names or processor request semantics changed.

Provider_Response: split-before-decode parsing, duplicate/malformed field rejection, required successful charge reference, known-PAN/CVV/credential echo rejection and whitelisted safe public fragments.

Rest_Authorization: HTTPS, authenticated WordPress identity, constant-time legacy key comparison, validated bounded order ID, owner or explicit backend capability plus order permission, indistinguishable unavailable/forbidden order errors.
limits: This comparison covers the six listed files only. Gateway orchestration and helper/compatibility changes have separate unit and real WordPress/WooCommerce checks; token identity is not a substitute for those checks.
